title: Native realization and lift of an invariant ordinary exceptional transpose
statement: Fix the ordinary restricted compact-support adjunction, the common-stage coefficient system, the forgetful realization models VX,VY and a native target L. For any native H and invariant ordinary carrier t from nativeShriek(H) to L, there are a native complex M realizing the common-stage right-adjoint value, an ordinary isomorphism d from M to the supplied ordinary right-adjoint value, and a native map q:H→M whose underlying map followed by d is the ordinary transpose of the carrier. No identification e for H, arbitrary native comparison a, transported-arrow equation, or invertibility conclusion is assumed.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib shift/adjunction material; source library Adjunction.shiftedHomEquiv supplies the formal graded step, not the geometric lift.
Standard adjunction Hom equivalence; no Frobenius realization or constructible cone criterion.
No matching declaration. Local searches found cyclic action realization, the cyclic Hom sequence, and the scalar Frobenius counit as component inputs.

proof.text: Construct the scalar-normalized right Frobenius mate and its invariant counit. Closure transport and the section equivalence identify its ordinary value with the right-adjoint value of the fixed ordinary compact-support functor. Uniqueness of right adjoints supplies d for the given adjunction.
Realize the invertible right Frobenius object as a bounded constructible native Weil complex M. The coefficient realization gives b:VX(M)≅G_stage(VY(L)).

The invariant counit identity carries the invariance of t to the invariance of its ordinary transpose. Apply degree-zero surjectivity of the cyclic derived Hom exact sequence to lift this transpose to q:H→M, and cancel the zero-shift unitor.

theorem native_exceptional_ordinary_mate_lift (R : Family l D)
    (X Y : Space D) (VX : ForgetModel D l R X) (VY : ForgetModel D l R Y)
    (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
    [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
    (h : ∀ K, ordinaryCounitProperty D l X K →
      ordinaryCounitProperty D l Y ((counitOrdinaryShriek D l f₀).obj K))
    (G : (ordinaryCounitProperty D l Y).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (ordinaryCounitProperty D l X).FullSubcategory)
    (adj : ordinaryCounitLeft D l f₀ h ⊣ G)
    (S : CoefficientSystem D l f₀) (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀))
    (L : W D l Y) (H : W D l X)
    (t : WeilComplex.forget.obj ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H) ⟶
      WeilComplex.forget.obj L)
    (hinv : (t ≫ (shiftFunctorZero _ ℤ).inv.app (WeilComplex.forget.obj L)) ∈
      CyclicDerivedHomInvariants (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l Y.base.left)
        ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H).obj L.obj) :
    ∃ (M : W D l X)
      (b : VX.functor.obj M ≅ (S.ring.operation c .closed).G.obj (VY.functor.obj L))
      (d : ordinaryCounitObject D l X M ≅ G.obj (ordinaryCounitObject D l Y L))
      (q : H ⟶ M),
      ObjectProperty.homMk (WeilComplex.forget.map q) ≫ d.hom =
        adj.homEquiv (ordinaryCounitObject D l X H) (ordinaryCounitObject D l Y L)
          (ObjectProperty.homMk ((counitForgetComparison D l f₀).inv.app H ≫ t))
